# go-chi

chi router idioms the Go adapter reads: r.Method, r.Get/r.Post, middleware via r.Use, and the stdlib net/http contract underneath.

## Error codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `AF-SFN-DUMP` | `state-machine.json` missing or invalid |
| `AF-TASK-TRANSITION` | state machine refuses the move |
